---
title: "MatchMiner-AI takes second place in the 2026 Hearst Health Prize"
description: "Recognition for matching patients to trials from the full medical record, with openly shared models."
date: 2026-06-01  # Month only; exact award date not confirmed
---

[MatchMiner-AI](../../matchminer-ai.qmd) took second place in the 2026 Hearst Health Prize, awarded at UCLA Health Data Day.

The recognition highlights its approach: matching patients to trials from the full medical record, with openly shared models trained on synthetic data.
